key_insight: Separate evidence used for agent reasoning from evidence authorized to justify persistent identity changes in entity resolution.
engineering_relevance: A commit-time authorization guardrail could limit unsupported identity-changing graph mutations without restricting exploratory agent reasoning.
method: Map selected DIO/ODI reconstruction-failure distinctions to domain-governed, identity-preserving constraints.
Promote evidence separately for each claim; UNVERIFIED admission grants no authorization eligibility.
Use a two-phase supervisor to check proposition coverage, conflict resolution, authorized scope, and state/policy version validity before commit.
evidence_signal: The paper proposes evaluation against generic authorization and conventional identifier rules but reports no implementation or empirical validation.
watch_item: Protection depends on adequate domain policies, evidence promotion, and enforcement; hypothesis-conditioned retrieval remains unaddressed.
paper_title: Constraining the Commit Boundary: A DIO/ODI-Informed Authorization Guardrail for Agentic Entity Resolution
